We were framed.|Marn Hierogryph|And&hellip;um&hellip;Suurjans don't have ears.|attr=Celeste Morne, Zayne Carrick, and Marn Hieroglyph, trying to avoid detection by [[Rakghoul]]s|src=<ref name="KOTOR 25">[[Knights of the Old Republic 25|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 25]]</ref>}}
The '''Suurjans''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Suurja]],<ref name="KOTOR 25" /> located in the [[Suurja system/Legends|Suurja system]] of the [[Ojoster sector/Legends|Ojoster sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Atlas">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}.</ref> Suurjans lacked ears.<ref name="KOTOR 25" />
